status: research hypotheses, not an approved specification or measured performance result
problem: Opening one drawing requires downloading historical messages before folding frontier state.

findings.claim: Snapdoc directly addresses authenticated document bootstrap without full signed history; RSA accumulators and Merkle consistency proofs are alternatives to ZK.
A joiner must request a refreshed snapshot for operations concurrent with its join snapshot; do not assume arbitrary old edits apply directly.
Automerge repo stores heads-keyed snapshots and incremental chunks, deleting only incorporated chunks; packaging compaction does not establish history-independent size.
Yjs supports state transfer and differences from state vectors, including binary-only diffing; mergeUpdates does not itself garbage-collect deleted content.
findings.location: Update API and Alternative Update API

findings.claim: Delta-state CRDT merging requires appropriate join structure and causal conditions; CBCL set-function folds do not automatically inherit this structure.
Delta propagation can waste enough bandwidth to resemble full state transfer; measure actual bytes and duplicate propagation.
Hash DAG heads commit to update ancestry; they do not alone prove that a supplied materialized state is the fold of that ancestry.
findings.location: section 3.1; state-proof distinction is our inference

findings.claim: CBCL fold returns projected values, while replacement selection uses key/address identities and dedup uses accepted addresses; displayed values are insufficient as generic resumable state.
Do not assume drawing collaborators are the quorum-runtime validator roster or that a bounded Byzantine fraction applies to them.
findings.location: Context and defaults; applicability warning is our inference

proposal.bootstrap: independently verifiable checkpoint manifest plus materialized resume state plus causal tail
proposal.endorsement: exact same manifest; compare only identical cuts; cached endorsements collected before open; quorum only under explicit pinned roster and fault policy
proposal.tail: all uncovered target ancestry, including concurrent branches; covered-dependency witnesses must stop recursive pre-checkpoint fetch
proposal.concurrency: different cuts can coexist; no globally selected checkpoint required
proposal.first_phase: retain archival history, optimize client transfer; postpone deletion
proposal.security_boundary: endorsements attest a computation under signer trust; hashes and inclusion proofs alone do not prove fold correctness or global freshness

open_questions: What drawing dialect and exact fold rules are in use?
What checkpoint signer trust policy is authorized for object members?
What compact metadata suffices for admission, replacements, deduplication and future edits?
How are covered ancestry, exclusion and external references witnessed without replay?
How are membership changes authenticated without an unbounded bootstrap chain?
How can recent checkpoints remain available when enough endorsers are offline?

workloads: fixed visible drawing, increasing overwrite/delete history
increasing live strokes at fixed history ratio
offline concurrent edits crossing checkpoint cut
replays and references to replaced/deleted identities
metrics: cold-open bytes and request round trips
time to first render and authenticated editable state separately
checkpoint producer CPU and attestation traffic
experiment.acceptance: Full replay and checkpoint-plus-tail agree on render, admission and subsequent edits; for fixed live content and a maintained checkpoint policy, cold-open must not require replay or transfer of the covered message history. No latency target is yet ratified.
